tickets.title: Add ticket-paths helper to validate files and suggest closest repo paths
acceptance: Every file a ticket writes or reads as context is checked against the real file tree before ingest.
A ticket naming a missing file is rejected with the closest real path suggested.

tickets.title: Wire ticket path validation into scope split --ingest
acceptance: scope split --ingest refuses a ticket whose files or context name a path missing from the repo.
The refusal message names the closest real path for each missing path.

tickets.title: Add lane-size module for per-lane byte budgets on split tickets
acceptance: The splitter sizes tickets by file bytes per lane (for example the Hermes 15 KB limit), not only file count.
A ticket too large for every cheap lane is split or routed to a lane that edits in place.

tickets.title: Apply lane byte sizing during split ingest and scope approve warnings
acceptance: scope split --ingest routes an oversize ticket to an in-place lane or refuses with a split hint.
swarm scope approve warns when a ticket exceeds the active lane byte budget.

tickets.title: Make build tickets own their test files in ticket-manifest prompts
acceptance: A build ticket writes or owns the test file that proves it, so there is no build → test → fix chain.
The critical path of a typical scope is shorter than before on the same input.

tickets.title: Keep test tickets after build modules in wiring order
acceptance: orderTestsAfterBuild leaves build tickets that list tests without waiting on separate test tickets.
A split ingest note is emitted when test ordering is flipped.

tickets.title: Wire build-owns-tests rules into scope split ingest
acceptance: scope split --ingest accepts a build ticket that lists tests in its tests field without a separate test ticket.
The ingest report shows a shorter dependency chain than test-first splits.

tickets.title: Filter acceptance lines to those provable from ticket files and auto context
acceptance: Every acceptance line can be checked from the ticket's own files plus context the splitter attaches automatically.
No acceptance line depends on a later ticket's files.

acceptanceResults.line: Every acceptance line can be checked from the ticket's own files plus context the splitter attaches automatically.
acceptanceResults.evidence: tools/acceptance-provable.mjs:71-102 and 131-168 allow only the ticket's own files, its context and contracts, auto context from buildTicketContext, and its dependencies' files. Any other path is dropped as outside-context.

acceptanceResults.line: No acceptance line depends on a later ticket's files.
acceptanceResults.evidence: tools/acceptance-provable.mjs:143-150 drops a line that names a file owned by a transitive dependent ticket, with code later-ticket-file.

tickets.title: Reject or trim unprovable acceptance lines at split ingest
acceptance: scope split --ingest refuses a build ticket whose acceptance names files it does not write or own.
Copied requirement acceptance lines skip route-level checks until the integration ticket exists.

tickets.title: Tag sensitive only for auth, database, payments, secrets and public routes
acceptance: Tickets are tagged sensitive only for auth, database, payments, secrets and public routes.
A scope like atlas store-wrapper no longer tags every ticket sensitive.

tickets.title: Use precise sensitive tagging during split ingest instead of scope phrase match
acceptance: scope split --ingest leaves sensitive false on a store-wrapper ticket that does not touch auth or customer data.
A ticket that writes a public API route is marked sensitive.

tickets.title: Compute file owners from open tickets and release done ticket files
acceptance: Done tickets release their files, and only open or running tickets block a file in a wave.
New tickets can list existing open tickets as dependsOn.

tickets.title: Expose existing ticket file locks to split workers and merge ingest
acceptance: scope split for a change order lists open tickets whose files would block new tickets.
scope split --ingest accepts dependsOn keys that reference existing ledger ticket ids.

tickets.title: Simulate ingest waves for slot count, fill and critical path length
acceptance: Before ingest the swarm simulates waves for the current slot count.
If the critical path is over 25% of tickets or average fill is under 50% of slots, it re-splits or asks.

tickets.title: Run wave simulation before scope split --ingest writes the ledger
acceptance: scope split --ingest refuses when simulated critical path exceeds 25% of tickets.
scope split --ingest asks the owner when average wave fill is under half the slot count.

tickets.title: Re-split or reroute blocked tickets after two failures without a manifest
acceptance: A ticket that blocks, or fails twice, is re-split or rerouted without the orchestrator writing a manifest.
The re-plan is logged with its reason.

tickets.title: Invoke ticket replan from scope sync when a ticket blocks or fails twice
acceptance: swarm scope sync logs a replan event with the ticket id and reason.
A replanned ticket returns to ready with smaller files or a different lane.

tickets.title: Validate delete-only tickets and migration ticket DDL rules
acceptance: A delete-only ticket passes sync once its files are gone.
Rename and migration tickets have their own type with matching checks.

tickets.title: Add rename ticket type validation alongside migration checks
acceptance: validateTicket accepts a rename ticket with exactly one new file and one deletes entry.
A migration ticket still requires DDL-only files under supabase/migrations.

tickets.title: Wire delete and rename ticket sync checks into scope sync integrated path
acceptance: swarm scope sync --integrated marks a delete-only ticket done when declared files are absent.
A rename ticket is refused until the old path is gone and the new path exists.

tickets.title: Exclude human tickets from build progress and wave blocking counts
acceptance: Human tickets do not count toward build progress or block wave planning.
They appear to the owner as a checklist with steps.

tickets.title: Show human ticket checklists on Swarm Watch plan tab without build progress
acceptance: Swarm Watch plan tab lists human tickets with their steps as a checklist.
Build progress percent ignores human tickets.

tickets.title: Owner validates human ticket checklist UX on Swarm Watch
acceptance: Human tickets do not count toward build progress or block wave planning.
They appear to the owner as a checklist with steps.
steps: Open Swarm Watch for a project with at least one human ticket in todo.
Confirm the plan tab shows the human ticket title and numbered steps.
Confirm build progress percent does not change when only human tickets are open.
Mark one human ticket done from the owner checklist flow.
Confirm wave planning still starts build tickets while human items remain open.

tickets.title: Document Ticket Manager v2 ingest and replan behavior in dogfood fixes design
acceptance: docs/plans/dogfood-fixes-design.md describes path validation, lane sizing, and wave simulation at ingest.
The doc names how human tickets are excluded from build progress.

tickets.title: Regression tests for ticket path validation at ingest
acceptance: Every file a ticket writes or reads as context is checked against the real file tree before ingest.
A ticket naming a missing file is rejected with the closest real path suggested.

tickets.title: Regression tests for split wave simulation thresholds
acceptance: Before ingest the swarm simulates waves for the current slot count.
If the critical path is over 25% of tickets or average fill is under 50% of slots, it re-splits or asks.

tickets.title: Regression tests for delete-only and rename ticket sync
acceptance: A delete-only ticket passes sync once its files are gone.
Rename and migration tickets have their own type with matching checks.
